example_label: Example data. Fictional agency and AI system. Not a real assessment.

answers.q5_changes: The agency added a summary template and a link to the injury form. The vendor model is unchanged.
answers.q6_description: InjuryDraft drafts a summary of a workplace injury report and can pull the report the reviewer already has. The agency added a template. A safety supervisor checks the draft before it is filed. Fictional system.
answers.q7_purpose: Reviewers now write summaries by hand from the injury packet. The assistant proposes a draft so the packet is easier to read. The supervisor still files the official summary. Fictional purpose.
answers.q8_how: A wrong summary could steer a safety review toward the wrong hazard or person.
answers.q14_sources: Workplace injury reports held by the injury review unit.
answers.q20_harm: A draft could omit a hazard or name the wrong work site. Workers and the employer bear that mistake if a reviewer files it unchanged. The safety supervisor is assigned to check each draft.
